businessGoal: Allow users to filter products by brand to enhance search functionality.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the brand filter checkboxes are displayed on the product overview page.
Verify that selecting one or more brand checkboxes updates the product grid to show only the selected brands.
Verify that selecting both categories and brands filters the product grid to show matching products.

manual.reason: The story involves visible UI elements and user interactions.

api.reason: The filtering behavior can be validated through the application's API capabilities.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria describe visible filter behavior on the product overview page.
